inputs.prompt: Keep everything in image 1 exactly as it is: the same room, the same camera position and framing, the same night light, and the same man asleep in the bed, who has not moved. Change two things. First: the laptop on the desk is open and its screen glows soft white, lighting the desk. Second: on the desk, beside the open laptop, stands a small owl made of soft mint light (#b7f4cf), about 20 centimetres tall, round and fluffy, its feathers drawn in fine threads of mint light, with a soft white face disc and big, calm, dark eyes with tiny mint highlights. It is a premium, almost photographic creature of light: not a cartoon, not bright green, with no orange beak or feet. The screen's light catches its face. It is busy at work: one wing rests on the laptop's keyboard as if typing, and it looks closely at the screen, focused and content. The phone on the bedside table is dark again. The sleeper is untouched. It must read as friendly, advanced technology, never as a ghost or a spirit: no mist, no smoke, no dark shadows, nothing spooky. Photorealistic, like a frame from a premium advertising film. Nothing written anywhere.

expect.unit: USD (the endpoint bills in units of 1 dollar, by tokens)
expect.basis: WP1 and WP3 paid 6 to 9 cents for a 2K picture on this model (demo-video/ledger/wp3.csv)

note: Concept C (a night owl of light, from the phone), still 2: it works at the laptop on the desk
